content.text: Tres y Dos (Three and Two) is a simple Rummy-style game from the Dominican Republic, Cuba, and Puerto Rico. Players draw and discard to form a 'Full House' â€” three cards of one rank plus two cards of another rank. First to complete this hand wins.

Tres y Dos is a folk rummy-style game played across the Dominican Republic, Cuba, and Puerto Rico. Contributors report that most Dominicans who have ever played cards know the game; it is often learned in childhood. In Cuba, children sometimes bet marbles on each hand while adults may play for money. The game has no formal documented history; it is transmitted informally as a household and social pastime.
Deal 5 cards each. Stock + Discard pile.
